cases.name: Login establishes an admin session
cases.expectation: login succeeds and the dashboard shell renders
observations: dashboard shell and settings center rendered

cases.name: Overview and registry render the single available descriptor
cases.expectation: settings-center.v1 overview and the core refresh descriptor appear

cases.name: Create a structurally valid business-invalid draft succeeds
cases.expectation: value 10 is accepted into a draft (no client 15..300 pre-rejection)

cases.name: Validate returns invalid with a blocker
cases.expectation: validate reports 验证未通过 with a blocker issue and the draft becomes invalid

cases.name: Publish control is unavailable / server state conflict for the invalid draft
cases.expectation: publish is refused (state conflict) or disabled while invalid

cases.name: Typed PATCH corrects the invalid draft to 60
cases.expectation: the invalid draft is corrected and becomes editable again

cases.name: Revalidate the corrected draft as validated
cases.expectation: validate reports 已验证 with no blockers

cases.name: Safe diff shows the exact public value change
cases.expectation: diff table shows before/after with public sensitivity and zero secrets

cases.name: Publish A (60 -> 90) with explicit confirmation
cases.expectation: publish succeeds atomically and navigates to history

cases.name: Publish B (90 -> 120) supersedes A
cases.expectation: a second publication succeeds

cases.name: History keeps A's original publish fact and Audit id
cases.expectation: A's published entry still shows 已发布 with its original Audit id

cases.name: Supersession is appended and visible as 已被后续版本取代
cases.expectation: A gains an appended superseded entry with the stable Chinese label

cases.name: Rollback draft from the current publication
cases.expectation: rollback creates a new draft with the source value

cases.name: Rollback publication appends a rollback_published event
cases.expectation: publishing the rollback draft appends a new published event

cases.name: Version conflict is distinguished from state conflict
cases.expectation: a stale expectedVersion yields VERSION_CONFLICT copy, not state conflict
observations: stale version PATCH refused with VERSION_CONFLICT

cases.name: State conflict is distinguished from version conflict
cases.expectation: publishing an unvalidated draft yields SETTINGS_STATE_CONFLICT copy
observations: publish of unvalidated draft refused with state conflict

cases.name: Malformed UUID yields a stable controlled 400
cases.expectation: a non-UUID draft id returns a controlled 400, never a 500
observations: malformed UUID status 400; valid missing UUID status 404

cases.name: Forbidden profile cannot mutate
cases.expectation: a read-only actor sees no create/publish controls
observations: read-only actor sees no create control

cases.name: Degraded readiness is shown, never fake-ready
cases.expectation: no-publication readiness renders degraded with reason
observations: compiled default generation 0/value 60 installed and matched

cases.name: No secret appears in the DOM
cases.expectation: no email/password/token/secret/connection string in the body text

cases.name: Published refresh interval drives the Overview cadence
cases.expectation: a validated draft's safe-diff before value binds the Overview refresh cadence
observations: published 15 seconds; observed Overview reload after 14.20s

cases.name: Readiness consumer generation mismatch is degraded
cases.expectation: a stale consumer generation renders degraded rather than ready
observations: stale generation 0 degraded; installed generation 1 ready

cases.name: Mutation Audit records real roles and permission snapshot
cases.expectation: a create mutation Audit row carries real effective roles and settings.write grant

cases.name: Settings writer sees 受控写入, read-only sees 只读模式
cases.expectation: the shell access-mode banner follows the server capability

cases.name: Logout and post-logout state are clean
cases.expectation: logout returns to login and no protected state remains
